name: Sejny (Poland)
description: Vertical bicolour of red and green, the red charged with a black bull's head between crossed lances and swords from the city arms, the green crossed by a white wavy horizontal band.
history: Polish gmina flags are established by resolution of the gmina council under the Act on Badges and Uniforms, normally after an opinion of the Heraldic Commission; the flag takes the colours of the arms.

features.role: bull's head from the city arms
lances and swords around the head
wavy band across the green half
